title: Lakeridge Highway
wikitext:
[[Image:Lakeridge Highway.jpg|thumb|300px|Lakeridge Highway]]
'''Lakeridge Highway''' is an old highway that runs along the southern edge of [[Lake Everstill]] in [[Redridge Mountains]]. The highway was originally highly traveled in the days before the [[First War]].  Since [[orc]]s have taken over [[Stonewatch Keep]] the highway has fallen into disuse.  Now [[gnoll]]s patrol most of the highway and travel on the road is not recommended.
